create_idefics_processor: create an IdeficsProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal input
call_idefics_processor: call the IdeficsProcessor to tokenize text and images into input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values tensors
add_eos_token_to_idefics: add an end-of-sequence token to IdeficsProcessor text output by setting add_eos_token kwarg
add_end_of_utterance_token_idefics: add end-of-utterance tokens between consecutive text segments in IdeficsProcessor prompts
generate_image_attention_mask: generate image attention masks for packed input ids using image_attention_mask_for_packed_input_ids
